full_judgment: 16. The learned Advocate Mr Abul Kalam Chowdhury, appeared on behalf of the respondent Nos. 3-5 submits that the allegations made in the Writ petition are not correct. The petitioner was transferred to Bangladesh Agricultural Institute, BARI Dhaka as Assistant Director (Administration) vide office order No. ব-১/৯৭/প্রশাসন/১৪৬৪ dated 2-9-1998 in the public interest. Actually it was not on deputation in the true sense of the term. Petitioner joined his new place of posting without raising any objection whatsoever. He further submits that Bangladesh Agricultural Institute (BAI) Dhaka, was a component organ of BARI upto 10-9-2001. The provision of Deputation as per Regulation 16 of BARI Service Regulations 1990 applies only when the service of an employee of an organisation is placed at the disposal of another organisation on the terms and conditions, mutually agreed upon by both the organisations. So, this provision was not applicable to the petitioner as he was transferred to a component organ of BARI. Therefore, his claim that he was on deputation of Bangladesh Agricultural Institute is not correct. Moreso, earlier the petitioner filed Title Suit No. 352 of 2000 before the 1st Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Gazipur against these respondents to declare his transfer at Bangladesh Agricultural Institute Dhaka illegal, to maintain his order of promotion dated 15-4-1996 by Director General BARI and for other reliefs. After contested hearing, plaint of said suit was rejected vide Judgment and decree dated 18-7-2002 and against the said order the petitioner filed Title Appeal No. 120 of 2002 which was also dismissed on contest, Petitioner wilfully suppressed all these fact.
